result:
I fixed 12 rules in `pricebook.py` so they follow their docstrings. Afterwards I checked all 150 rules against a reference built from each docstring. It used quantities 0–399 and 9 unit prices, and found no mismatches.

| Rule | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| 18 | Applied 11% | 10% |
| 34 | Threshold was 31 | 30 |
| 62 | Threshold was 13 | 12 (prices were already correct, because the discount at 12 units is 0; this only matches the docstring) |
| 73 | Whole rule calculated as marginal | Whole-order discount |
| 133 | Whole rule calculated as marginal | Whole-order discount |
| 138 | Marginal rule calculated as whole | Discount only on units above 5 |
| 94, 95, 146 | Used `round()`, against the module rule to round down to the won | `// 100` (round down) |
| 100 | Used `qty > 20`, so exactly 20 units got no discount | `qty >= 20` |
| 134 | Threshold was 21 | 20 |
| 139 | Capped the price at 10,000 won instead of the discount | Calculates the discount first, then caps it at 10,000 won |

STATUS: DONE
